messages:
elinor: Heads-up — we need to schedule a coordinated base image rotation + attestation rollout. Goal: swap root certs, rotate cosign signing key to KMS, and enable immutable image attestations in staging this week. Who can own RBAC changes?
marc: I can take RBAC. Need to know which service accounts will push signed images and who reads attestations.
anya.k: For KMS: we need to decide between customer-managed keys vs platform keys for cosign. Platform prefers CMK with limited principals.
samir: Question: does the attestation flow require new audit sinks? We should stream attestations to an append-only audit log (separate from normal registry logs).
elinor: yes — security asked that attestations + cosign metadata go to the audit trail. Proposal: a dedicated Cloud Audit Logs sink -> BigQuery + 90d cold storage. Thoughts?
marc: sounds good. I'll draft the IAM policy. Quick sketch:```
- allow: iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob
- resource: projects/_/serviceAccounts/cosign-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- condition: request.auth.audiences == "cosign"
```
anya.k: For cosign with KMS we use the kms:// URI, e.g. `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...` test in staging before prod. Also need `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the signer SA.
samir: Vulnerability triage note: rebuilding images bumped glibc in a test image which flagged a CVE in scanner. We should pin package versions and run distro security updates in a reproducible build step.
elinor: Agree. Add an SBOM generation step (syft) and store SBOMs alongside attestations. That will help triage.
marc: I'll open a PR for RBAC and a policy doc for the audit sink. Linking initial PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtimes/pulls/482
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch `image-rotation/rbac-482` — build 2026.03.20.15:02 started :gear:
security-bot: Note: schedule an on-call review when we flip signing key. I recommend a 30-min maintenance window and canary images in us-west1/us-east1.
anya.k: Also: runtime agents need permission to fetch attestations — add `container.images.getAttestations` to platform-reader role.
elinor: OK — action items: (1) marc PR for RBAC + IAM (2) anya to test cosign+KMS in staging and share commands (3) samir to add SBOM+upgrade pin in build pipeline (4) schedule 30-min canary window — I'll coordinate with SRE.
marc: I'll post RFC and tag @oncall before the key flip.
anya.k: Test commands to try:```
cosign generate-key-pair
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/base/cryptoKeys/cosign --output-signature image.sig registry/repo/image:staging
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/base/cryptoKeys/cosign registry/repo/image:staging
```
samir: Leaving a reminder to run the vulnerability scan after rebuild: `snyk test --docker registry/repo/image:staging` and attach results to the ticket.
elinor: Thanks all — next status update in #eng-security after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
